header: The pads' plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs, played with its tools/gamepad_probe.js as the preload
(--preload): tools/play_plan.json's play with four stand-in pads plugged in at the launcher, before Start Game, as a
player's pads are there when the game starts. Their ids are Chrome's on Windows for an Xbox pad over XInput (two),
a DualSense and a Bluetooth Xbox pad, whose ids are longer than SDL keeps and which SDL renames, so the page has to
find each by its place in navigator.getGamepads(). Each pad plays a port of its own in the order they were plugged
in (RECOMPINPUT_PADS_IN_ORDER): the battle on Peach's Castle has ports 2-4 played by their pads, which stand still,
and port 1 the computer's Mario, whose hits start each port's Rumble Pak. It needs a Rumble Pak in all four ports
at the title (motor(port), the game's own osMotorInit) and, after a minute of the game's time, rumble that reached
the pads of ports 2, 3 and 4 (padRumbles(): plays per pad, in the order they were plugged in), then runs the
battle's clock out to its results.
load: RT64: all [0-9]+ prebuilt shaders built|once the game draws
start: plugPads(["Xbox 360 Controller (XInput STANDARD GAMEPAD)","Xbox 360 Controller (XInput STANDARD GAMEPAD)","DualSense Wireless Controller (STANDARD GAMEPAD Vendor: 054c Product: 0ce6)","Xbox Wireless Controller (STANDARD GAMEPAD Vendor: 045e Product: 0b13)"])
play: (() => { const plays = padRumbles().split(' ').slice(1, 5).map(Number); return plays[1] > 0 && plays[2] > 0 && plays[3] > 0; })()
